Crippling Bolt
8% of base mana
Instant
Requires One-Handed Melee Weapon
Requires Crossbow Stance
Fires a crossbow bolt at an enemy, dealing Off-hand Damage plus 3+(PL*0.8), scaling with ranged attack power.

Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

Generates 8 Rage. Can only be used directly after Coiling Shot.
